text: ドラゴン　ぐんだんが　まける　なんて　しんじられない　レッド！

structure.jp: ドラゴン　ぐんだんが　まける　なんて
structure.en: that my Dragon army would lose

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて after a statement holds it up with shock: 'to think that...'. まける　なんて = 'to think it would lose'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: The られる ending here means 'can do', and ない makes it 'cannot'. しんじられない = 'I can't believe it'.
